audit.architecture: Single local desktop client with lightweight MVVM, application services, local JSON persistence, winget CLI integration, and WiX-based installer sources.
audit.delivery_model: Repository scripts build the app and generate a WiX Burn setup EXE with internal x86/x64 MSI payloads. GitHub Actions runs the repository build gate on windows-latest.
audit.maturity: Repository setup, formatting, warning-as-error build, unit/UI tests, run entrypoint, and package generation are supported and passed in this audit.
audit.risk_summary: No concrete open backlog was identified during this audit. Release deployment remains outside this repository because no deploy or release workflow is versioned.
